title: Strict Inclusion of Tree Size Classes
statement: The class of Boolean languages that can be recognized by a family of Boolean circuit trees whose size is at most $1$ for every input length is a proper subset of the class recognizable by such a family with size at most $\max\bigl(1,2^{\min(n,3)}(\min(n,3)+1)+1\bigr)$ on inputs of length $n$.
